originalScenarioUnchanged.exactOriginalText: TU4-05-A: A recorded 200-cubic-foot quantity is redirected ten feet from an open basin into a real adjacent channel with sufficient volume. The basin loses that exact quantity and the channel receives it once. Releasing concentration leaves it in the channel under ordinary flow; neither the basin nor abstract Supply is refilled.

qualifications: The coordinates are declared test geometry. Container walls, actual open route, water support during movement and capacity after release need actual authored physical fixtures; these boxes alone do not prove them.

originalScenarioUnchanged.exactOriginalText: TU4-05-B: An unwilling swimmer in the selected water fails STR and moves ten feet along a legal open path. A second paid control Action that numbered round cannot force another displacement attempt on that same creature. A moored boat in the water does not break its real tether merely because the caster declared Redirect.

qualifications: Actual swimmer immersion/current/breath and boat profiles are not established by this vector. It grants no second Action or damage. The whole-body swept corridor now needs actual fluid clearance throughx27.5. This required clearance is not a claim of1600ft3 selected water, new water creation, immunity to immersion or proved buoyancy. Bind the real selected quantity and continuous fluid/airway state under Q02 before a completed case.

originalScenarioUnchanged.exactOriginalText: TU4-06-A: A synthetic admitted mundane recipe has Q4, DC12, forty pounds of real stock and four eight-pound Standard outputs, with adequate packaging and otherwise valid tools/formula. A total of 12 makes four finished units during the one casting Action; eight pounds remain recorded as the actual recipe waste. No ordinary eight-hour work period is fabricated and no trade XP is awarded by this proposal.

qualifications: Full recipe ID/formula/tool/station/skill modifier/face, ingredients, output geometry and actual first-success record remain required. Total12 alone is not a sourced four-degree task roll.

originalScenarioUnchanged.exactOriginalText: TU4-06-B: A source Enchanting order needs an admitted ordinary sword body plus actual magical process inputs and imbuement work. Fabricate cannot finish that magical order. A separate eligible mundane sword recipe can supply a real ordinary sword from its own complete raw materials, after which the actual Enchanting order still needs all of its own inputs, work and source permissions.

qualifications: The original two unnamed orders remain conditional. An actual ordinary sword equipment profile is not by itself a complete manufacture recipe or Enchanting credential.

originalScenarioUnchanged.exactOriginalText: TR5-01-A: An eligible20cubic-foot sand patch inside the full60-foot-radius area becomes20cubic feet of ice. The reference input2000lb becomes1140lb output under the explicit transmutation exception. There is one transformed lot, not both sand and ice; melting it later creates no second parallel stock entry or guaranteed clean-water certificate.

qualifications: Material density defaults, exact occupied-volume handling, local ice durability/support/slip and later melting remain the explicit questions. No unseen parallel stock or later melt Action is invented.

originalScenarioUnchanged.exactOriginalText: TR5-01-B: Swamp-to-stone affects only the eligible top foot and leaves living roots, creatures and a built bridge untouched. A creature's occupied body is not filled with stone. The spell does not mine the new rock, supply a finished masonry item or let a merchant buy the same old mud and transformed stone separately.

qualifications: Exact root/bridge/body collision meshes and the component/clearance fork must be supplied before asserting a numeric converted volume. Rectangular terrain bounds do not erase these objects.

originalScenarioUnchanged.exactOriginalText: TR5-04-A: An800lb total Large armored creature and a150lb Medium ally in metal armor both lie in the sphere. Each actual unwilling subject makes STR; a failed result moves that whole subject up to20feet toward center, stopping at blockers. Two metal armor pieces on the same ally do not cause two saves or40feet of movement.

qualifications: The800lb Large creature has no actual operative profile here. Neither actual STR save nor final collision stop is fabricated; a150lb total alone cannot certify body/armor masses or metal composition. The low sphere point makes a literal3D straight pull descend toward the ground for both subjects. Their larger whole bodies cannot penetrate that floor: a failed save alone does not prove a positive displacement. Under Q09 explicitly resolve center/arrival geometry, collision order and ground blocking without silently projecting a3D pull onto horizontal ground or granting flight. No final stop/distance is asserted here.

originalScenarioUnchanged.exactOriginalText: TR5-04-B: An unattended metal breastplate is pulled without a save, but a coin purse alone does not qualify its unarmored carrier. A1400lb metal body exceeds the explicit new cap and is not moved. A failed pull against a rigid fixed anchor neither tears off the armor nor manufactures crushing damage.

qualifications: Full item/body/anchor geometry and genuine material identities are still required. No armor is stripped from a wearer by treating it as unattended.

originalScenarioUnchanged.exactOriginalText: TR5-06-A: A declared tunnel crosses a12-foot ordinary stone wall and opens to a real empty corridor. Creatures walk through the actual opening using real movement. An unknown25-foot thickness would instead defeat the paid formation; the spell supplies neither a portal nor an exact wall-thickness scan.

qualifications: Both wall material and real far-side receiving corridor must exist. Actual moving bodies spend their own real movement; the spell supplies no travel Action or portal.

originalScenarioUnchanged.exactOriginalText: TR5-06-B: At closure a creature stands near one mouth. The closest reachable legal adjacent exterior space receives its whole body and carried gear by the bounded ejection. If both mouths are blocked, a recorded local conflict preserves that one body until legal removal; no arbitrary burial damage, duplicate gear or search for a distant safe room is allowed.

qualifications: Exact ejection rule, closing clearance, fluid capacity and distinction between suppressed-live and final-ended application remain Q11. No actual antimagic cast or resource-free closure trigger is invented.

originalScenarioUnchanged.exactOriginalText: TR5-08-A: A real10cubic-foot mud lot becomes10cubic feet of ordinary stone: reference mass700→1500lb under the explicit conversion exception. The owner must still excavate/transport the actual1500lb and cannot sell the old700lb mud separately. No gem,source-tier upgrade,perfect brick wall or automatic crafting success is created.

qualifications: Actual mud/stone admission, whole-body clearance, density/solid durability and excavation permissions remain explicit; the spell grants no real excavation Action.

originalScenarioUnchanged.exactOriginalText: TR5-08-B: An eligible unsupported ceiling section becomes mud and its bounded burst rolls15bludgeoning. An affected creature saving takes7before other defenses, once for that converted falling mass. A different occupied muddy region hardened to stone leaves actual creature clearance rather than petrifying its occupants. Previously damaged solid stock does not return at fullHP merely through mud and back.

qualifications: The4d6 burst itself is proposed new authorship, and actual ceiling support/source geometry must qualify. The separate occupied mud and damaged-stock obligations remain explicit pending complete geometry/HP rules; they are not claimed demonstrated by this target trace.

originalScenarioUnchanged.exactOriginalText: TU6-04-A: A complete30-by20-by20-foot timber building and its actual occupants/contents weigh80000lb. Its disconnected fittings,clear swept space and compatible supported destination permit a20-foot horizontal move. The same furniture,people and damaged roof arrive once;neither new loot nor repaired timbers appear. An occupant at a reachable exterior edge may use the proposed successful-DEX5-foot escape.

qualifications: Bounding box/mass alone do not prove a real building/support/soil profile. Occupant escape, actual supports, clear swept space and final capacity must be supplied; no success die or physical structure is invented.

originalScenarioUnchanged.exactOriginalText: TU6-04-B: A corner20feet from the chosen rotation axis would travel about31.416feet in a90-degree rotation,exceeding the30-foot point-path limit even though90degrees is the nominal angular maximum. That declared move is ineligible;choose a smaller legal rotation before casting. A destination over an unsupported pit is likewise not a legal way to use the spell for automatic building-scale crushing damage.

qualifications: A smaller angle alone does not prove every other point/collision/support constraint. The original example remains an eligibility rejection, not a paid successful move or crushing attack.

originalScenarioUnchanged.exactOriginalText: TU6-06-A: The caster moves an actual10-by10-by10-foot block-equivalent of loose earth,1000cubic feet,into a legal nearby berm inside the40-foot cube. The excavation and berm contain the same material. A200-cubic-foot existing cavity cannot receive all1000without another legal receiving volume;the extra800cannot vanish or become compressed commodity stone.

qualifications: Full final berm mesh, parcel mapping, continuous path, actual stable slope and material profile are still required. Source volume fits the cap but is not proof of any particular final legal berm.

originalScenarioUnchanged.exactOriginalText: TU6-06-B: An occupant on affected ground fails DEX,rides the actual legal ground displacement and becomes Prone. If the plan instead removes support,it faces real falling from its actual height,not a separate invented6d6spell attack. A concealed immovable object preventing the declared conserved transition can cause paid failure without disclosing a secret tunnel map or deleting that object.

qualifications: No actual final terrain mesh or landing/swept path is supplied, so the fall is a conditional timing/dice obligation, not a completed damage event. Actual die faces/life consequences belong to the eventual full vector.
